status: Preserved exploratory studies. Obsidian recommended as a working baseline; final treatment and production implementation remain unapproved.
userDirection: Explore a contemporary 2026 RTS look without being constrained to current visual fit; retain selection-owned information and actions; review mocks before implementation.

directions.Obsidian: Condensed typography, dark mineral surfaces, mint emphasis, compact two-row action grid.
directions.Ivory: Warm pale information surfaces, editorial serif names, selection ribbon and horizontal action strip.
directions.Citadel: Framed portraits, brass edge details, inset command tiles, circular minimap.

illustration.prompt: Premium contemporary fantasy RTS battlefield background plate, 16:9 elevated orthographic camera with no horizon. Stylized 3D lit materials and simplified readable shapes. Sunlit grassy meadow, branching pale dirt roads, turquoise creek toward upper right, slate outcrops and pine/birch edges. Ivory stone frontier village with dark teal roofs upper left; broad barracks and drill yard center right; open meadow across lower half. Warm afternoon light, small blue building flags, few tiny human silhouettes. No UI, labels, logos, frames or selection rings.
illustration.usage: Illustrative backdrop embedded as a compressed JPEG in the study; not an actual game frame or selected world-art replacement.

fonts: Google Fonts: DM Sans, Barlow Condensed, Fraunces.
icons: Host Lucide icons used for functional command studies; bespoke final icon art remains future work.
delivery: Standalone HTML embeds artwork and uses external font/icon libraries. Original fragment and earlier selection-layout alternatives remain in the originating task visualization directory.
storyboard: Select Worker: identity, health, task, cargo, economy orders.
Build: palette opens above dock; Economy, Military and Defenses categories.
Choose building and click field: wood decreases, Worker task changes, target marker appears.
Select Barracks: construction palette closes; production queue, products, research and rally replace worker controls.
Train: costs deducted and queue extended. Cancel: item removed and costs refunded.
Low food/population full: products unavailable with local explanation.
Army: composition, stances and military orders only; targeting updates order state.
Esc: closes disclosure, then cancels target, then clears selection.
Right click field: Move for units, Rally for Barracks.

observations: Worker build menu closed when Barracks selected.

320px Ivory/Citadel content width and scroll width both 288px.
Research requirements visible on narrow Citadel.
Low-food fixture displayed 20 food and Not enough food in a dusk scene.
historicalMockVerification.staticValidation: JavaScript syntax checked with node --check; fragment under 1 MB.

limits: UI-only prototype, no real gameplay simulation.
Queue progress, clock and income rates are illustrative fixed values.
No ordinary-game acceptance, implementation, deployment or balance claims.
Painting of final icons, final type sizes at actual game resolution, collision-safe placement and live queue timing remain implementation work.
Mock costs, bindings, requirements, stance options and Escape sequencing are illustrative, not authoritative game specifications.
Copy preservation verifies file hashes, not a new browser playtest.
next: Create a single real-data component/state specimen and compare portrait framing before production HUD implementation.
